test_title: PYST 22: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements**:

All crows are sparrows.

No crow is a pigeon.

**Conclusions (I): **No sparrow is a pigeon.

**Conclusions (II): **Some pigeons are crows.
solution:
The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93cb8d9eb4e83a589f396f49a58b449c15686f514eef9b1f9eeb4ef578feda0b.png] 

Conclusions (I): No sparrow is a pigeon. - False (As their is no direct relation between sparrow and pigeon so, no sparrow is a pigeon" may be possible but not definite.)

Conclusions (II): Some pigeons are crows.- False (No crow is a pigeon so, Some pigeons are crows" is false)

Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
